āśrama (EI 13) a stage of life; a religious establishment (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXX, p. 67); cf. Caṇḍik-āśrama-guru (IA 11), ‘the Superior of the hermitage of Caṇḍikā’.
 (IE

āśraya (IA 20), subdivision of a viṣaya.
 Cf. āśiriyam, āśiriya-kkal, āśiriya-ppramāṇam (SITI), a document by which a person submits to another's protection.
